title: Step 2 - How to Scale Numeric Features in Python for ML Preprocessing

cues.en: -: All right. So as usual, you know, in order to be as much efficient as we can, we're gonna do this with scikit-learn, right?
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，為了提高效率，我們會使用 scikit-learn。

cues.en: This data science library that has all the tools and the tool that we're about to use is a class called Standard Scaler in which will exactly perform standardization
cues.zh: 這個資料科學函式庫有各種工具，這次要用的類別叫做 StandardScaler，會對訓練集

cues.en: on both your matrix of features of the training set and the matrix of features of the test set.
cues.zh: 與測試集的特徵矩陣，進行標準化。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們開始。

cues.en: Let's start by importing this class which we have to take first from, well scikit-learn of course, sklearn and then from which we're gonna get access to
cues.zh: 先匯入這個類別，當然要從 sklearn 開始，再取得

cues.en: the pre-processing module, perfect, which is a module that contains that standard scaler class.
cues.zh: preprocessing 模組，StandardScaler 就在裡面。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So then we are ready to import what we want which is the standard scaler class. Perfect.
cues.zh: 接著匯入 StandardScaler 類別，很好。

cues.en: So now we have the class and then the natural next step here is of course to create an object of the class.
cues.zh: 有了類別，下一步自然是建立它的物件。

cues.en: I'm about to reveal soon that answer to one of the most frequent questions in the data science community.
cues.zh: 很快就會揭曉資料科學社群最常問的問題之一。

cues.en: So let's create this object.
cues.zh: 先建立物件。

cues.en: We're gonna call it sc for standard scaler.
cues.zh: 命名為 sc，代表 StandardScaler。

cues.en: And then while this object will be created as an instance of the standard scaler class, so I'm taking it here placing that right here, adding some parenthesis
cues.zh: 這個物件是 StandardScaler 的實例，所以把類別名稱放在這裡，加上括號。

cues.en: and good news, here we don't have any arguments to input because what we simply wanna do is get that mean, get that standard deviation, and then apply this formula
cues.zh: 好消息是，不需要傳入任何引數，因為只要取得平均數與標準差，再套用這個公式，

cues.en: to all the values in the feature.
cues.zh: 處理特徵中的所有數值。

cues.en: And for this, we don't need actually any parameters.
cues.zh: 這裡不需要額外參數。

cues.en: This will automatically do the job.
cues.zh: 它會自動完成。

cues.en: All right, So then next step.
cues.zh: 接著，下一步。

cues.en: And now, well, now is the time for me to reveal the answer to that question which is one of the most frequently asked questions
cues.zh: 現在終於要回答那個在資料科學社群中，

cues.en: in the data science community.
cues.zh: 經常被問到的問題。

cues.en: And that question is, do we have to apply feature scaling you know, standardization to the dummy variables
cues.zh: 問題是：需要對特徵矩陣中的虛擬變數，

cues.en: in the matrix of features?
cues.zh: 也套用標準化，也就是特徵縮放嗎？

cues.en: This is one of the most frequently asked questions.
cues.zh: 這是最常見的問題之一。

cues.en: You will find it everywhere online as well.
cues.zh: 網路上到處都看得到。

cues.en: And once again, actually the answer is pretty obvious but only after you get the explanation.
cues.zh: 同樣地，理解原因後，答案其實很明顯。

cues.en: So let me tell you the answer.
cues.zh: 我先告訴你答案。

cues.en: The answer is no, The answer is no, because simply, well remember the goal of standardization or feature scaling in general,
cues.zh: 答案是不需要。因為別忘了，標準化，或一般特徵縮放的目的，

cues.en: it is to have all the values of the features in the same range.
cues.zh: 是讓各個特徵值都落在相同範圍。

cues.en: And since I told you that standardization actually transforms your features so that they take values between more or less minus three and plus three,
cues.zh: 標準化會把特徵值大致調到 -3 與 +3 之間。

cues.en: while since here our dummy variables already take values between minus three and plus three because they're equal to either one or zero.
cues.zh: 而這裡的虛擬變數本來就是 0 或 1，已經落在 -3 到 +3 之間。

cues.en: Well, there is nothing extra to be done here with standardization.
cues.zh: 所以不需要再額外做標準化。

cues.en: And actually, standardization will only make it worse because indeed it will still transform these values between minus three and plus three.
cues.zh: 實際上，標準化反而可能讓情況變差，雖然數值仍會被調到大約 -3 到 +3，

cues.en: But then you will totally lose the interpretation of these variables.
cues.zh: 但變數的解讀就會變得困難。

cues.en: In other words, you will lose the information of which country corresponds to the observation.
cues.zh: 換句話說，會難以直接知道觀測值對應哪個國家。

cues.en: Now, we perfectly know that, you know remember, one zero and zero corresponds to France because that's how it was encoded, and then zero, zero and one corresponds to Spain.
cues.zh: 目前我們很清楚，[1, 0, 0] 是 France，因為編碼就是這樣，而 [0, 0, 1] 是 Spain。

cues.en: But you know, after we apply feature scaling if we apply it on the dummy variables we will get nonsense numerical values and we will be absolutely uncapable to say,
cues.zh: 但如果對虛擬變數做特徵縮放，就會變成不直觀的數值，無法直接判斷

cues.en: which tuple of three values here correspond to which country.
cues.zh: 哪一組三個數值對應哪個國家。

cues.en: So we will totally lose the interpretation.
cues.zh: 因此會失去原本的可解讀性。

cues.en: And besides this won't improve at all, the training performance because indeed our dummy variables are any way already between the same scale range as your other variables.
cues.zh: 而且，它們本來就與其他變數落在類似尺度，這樣做對訓練表現也不一定有幫助。

cues.en: You will see online that applying standardization to your dummy variables might still increase slightly the performance, you know, the final accuracy of your model.
cues.zh: 網路上可能會說，標準化虛擬變數，仍可能稍微提高模型最終準確率。

cues.en: But I've experimented many times and I've never seen, you know a considerable difference that would justify here to apply feature scaling on the dummy variables.
cues.zh: 但我做過很多次實驗，沒有看到足以支持這麼做的明顯差異。

cues.en: So really don't do this.
cues.zh: 所以，這裡不要這麼做。

cues.en: Only apply feature scaling to your numerical values.
cues.zh: 只對數值特徵進行特徵縮放。

cues.en: Right here, we have clearly some variables taking values in a very different range, right?
cues.zh: 這裡明顯有尺度差異很大的變數。

cues.en: The age goes between zero and 100 and the salary goes between zero and 100,000.
cues.zh: 年齡介於 0 到 100，而薪資介於 0 到 100,000。

cues.en: So clearly here, if it's better for the missionary model we have to apply feature scaling but let's leave these dummy variables alone so that we can keep the interpretability of the model.
cues.zh: 如果模型需要，就應該對它們縮放，但虛擬變數先保持原樣，保留可解讀性。

cues.en: All right, so that was the other very important questions.
cues.zh: 這就是另一個重要問題。

cues.en: Now I've covered everything.
cues.zh: 現在該說的都已經說明。

cues.en: There should not be any confusion left in data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 資料前處理應該不再有任何疑惑了。

cues.en: I'm really glad that you know this.
cues.zh: 很高興你已經知道這些。

cues.en: And therefore I encourage you now to press pause on this video, and guess what will be the next step to apply feature scaling to our matrices of feature x train and x test.
cues.zh: 現在建議先暫停影片，猜猜下一步如何對 X_train 與 X_test 進行特徵縮放。
